story.title: STORY OF A PENCIL
paragraphs_en: One day there a boy was sitting along with his grandmother. Grandmother was writing a letter. The boy looked at the grandmother and asked,is it about me that you are writing ? Grandmother stopped writing and looked at the boy and said"I am writing about you , but more than that it is the pencil I am using is important " "I hope you will also be like this Pencil when you grow up"

The boy was thinking "It looks like any other pencil which i have ever seen !! " "That depends on how you look at things" Said Grandma. "This pencil has got 5 qualities which if you adopt it, you will be a better person when you grow up" The First quality : You are capable of doing great things and are guided by an invisible hand and we call it God.

"Second quality is that we have to sharpen the Pencil while writing. It causes sufferings for the Pencil but it gets sharpened. So you must be ready to take pain and sacrifices it will make you a better person"

﻿ "Third quality of a pencil is that it allows us to erase the mistake done by it means correcting the mistakes we have done is not a bad thing ,and instead it lead us to justice" "Fourth quality of the pencil is that even though it has a beautiful wooden exterior, the graphite inside it , that matters . So try to look into the inside of you and see what happens inside"
" And finally the fifth quality of the Pencil is that whatever it writes it always leaves a mark. So you also remember that you will leave a mark in everything you do, be conscious about what you do"

sentences.text_vi: Việc đó gây ra đau đớn cho cây bút chì nhưng nó lại được gọt sắc hơn.

sentences.text_en: So you must be ready to take pain and sacrifices it will make you a better person"
sentences.text_vi: Vì vậy, cháu phải sẵn sàng chịu đựng đau đớn và hy sinh, điều đó sẽ giúp cháu trở thành một người tốt hơn."

sentences.text_en: ﻿ "Third quality of a pencil is that it allows us to erase the mistake done by it means correcting the mistakes we have done is not a bad thing ,and instead it lead us to justice" "Fourth quality of the pencil is that even though it has a beautiful wooden exterior, the graphite inside it , that matters .
sentences.text_vi: "Phẩm chất thứ ba của bút chì là nó cho phép chúng ta xóa bỏ lỗi lầm đã mắc phải, nghĩa là sửa chữa những lỗi chúng ta đã làm không phải là điều xấu, mà thay vào đó nó dẫn chúng ta đến sự công bằng." "Phẩm chất thứ tư của bút chì là dù nó có vẻ ngoài bằng gỗ đẹp đẽ, nhưng ruột chì (graphite) bên trong mới là điều quan trọng.

sentences.text_en: So try to look into the inside of you and see what happens inside"
sentences.text_vi: Vì vậy, hãy cố gắng nhìn vào bên trong con người cháu và xem điều gì đang diễn ra bên trong."

sentences.text_en: " And finally the fifth quality of the Pencil is that whatever it writes it always leaves a mark.
sentences.text_vi: "Và cuối cùng, phẩm chất thứ năm của cây bút chì là bất cứ điều gì nó viết ra đều luôn để lại dấu vết.

sentences.text_en: So you also remember that you will leave a mark in everything you do, be conscious about what you do"
sentences.text_vi: Vì vậy, cháu cũng hãy nhớ rằng cháu sẽ để lại dấu ấn trong mọi việc cháu làm, hãy ý thức về những gì cháu làm."
